title: Kill Bots Lip Sync
eyebrow: GPOM scene A · lip-sync pass, 18 Nov · round 3 (pauses moved)
heading: The toilet row: pick the best lip sync per line
intro: Round 3, lines 1, 3 and 5: the voice re-made with Gemini's pause tags so its pauses sit where the clip's mouth pauses (same words), plus 32 new clips that write the pause as an action. Pairs are now ranked by how many words land inside film's lip-sync tolerance (45 ms early to 125 ms late). Lines 2 and 4 keep your round-2 picks. Voices marked 'new model' are Gemini 3.8: listen for whether Sandra still sounds like Sandra.
